pages.title: Mutated Enderpearl
pages.text: An ender pearl twisted by Loran and Anima. Hold right click to draw it back like a bow and release to send it flying. Where it strikes a block, you are teleported right to that spot, briefly blinded and cloaked in invisibility as you arrive. The pearl wears out after a few throws. It is also needed to craft the Ring of Teleport.
